# Powers & Santola, LLP

> > A medical malpractice and personal injury law firm serving upstate New York with expertise in cancer misdiagnosis, wrongful death, and catastrophic injury claims.

Powers & Santola, LLP is a full-service personal injury and medical malpractice law firm with offices throughout upstate New York, including Albany, Syracuse, and Rochester. The firm specializes in complex medical negligence cases, delayed cancer diagnoses, birth injuries, and catastrophic personal injuries from accidents.

## Key Topics

- Medical Malpractice
- Personal Injury Law
- Wrongful Death
- Failure to Diagnose
- Delayed Diagnosis
- Medical Negligence
- Cancer Misdiagnosis
- Birth Injury
- Traumatic Brain Injury
- Motor Vehicle Accidents
- Construction Accidents
- Nursing Home Abuse
- Product Liability
- Sexual Abuse Claims
- Upstate New York
